title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 135 West Spring Street in Titusville, Pennsylvania, as the "Edwin L. Drake Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 135 West Spring Street in Titusville, Pennsylvania, as the Edwin L. Drake Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Renames a U.S. Postal Service building in Titusville, Pennsylvania, after oil pioneer Edwin L. Drake.
summary.what_it_does: This act officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 135 West Spring Street in Titusville, Pennsylvania, the Edwin L. Drake Post Office Building. It changes only the building's official name and does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The act was enacted on January 4, 2025, and the designation took effect on that date.
